services.tagline: The Ultimate Shield for Your Vehicle’s Paint
introduction: At Shalom Car & Bike Detailing Services, we offer the most advanced solution to protect your vehicle’s paint — Paint Protection Film, commonly known as PPF.
This transparent, high-gloss film acts as a rugged and highly effective barrier that safeguards your vehicle from daily wear and tear like scratches, swirl marks, and stone chips.
keyBenefits: Scratch and stone chip resistance to maintain a factory-finish look
Protection against UV rays and oxidation, preventing fading or discoloration
Self-healing surface that erases light scratches and swirl marks
Resistance to bird droppings, bug splatter, tree sap, and cleaning chemicals
Enhanced paint gloss with a premium, showroom-like shine
Clear, invisible application that blends perfectly with your car’s body
Improved resale value by preserving original paint condition
Easy maintenance with a hydrophobic surface — no waxing needed
Custom-fit coverage options based on your vehicle’s design and usage

whyChoose.heading: Superior Protection
whyChoose.description: Worried about accidental scratches in the parking lot or by curious kids in the neighborhood? Our Self-Healing Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) PPF is designed to prevent deep scratches and gashes from damaging your original paint.

whyChoose.heading: Self-Healing Technology
whyChoose.description: Our premium TPU films automatically heal minor swirl marks and superficial scratches caused by improper washing.

whyChoose.heading: Durability & Warranty
whyChoose.description: We offer PPF with 5, 7, 8, and 10-year warranty plans — choose one that suits your needs and budget.

whyChoose.heading: Comprehensive Coverage
whyChoose.description: Enhance protection with add-ons like wheel coatings, glass coatings, and plastic trim protection — all under one roof.

importantNotes: The warranty is provided by the PPF brand manufacturer. Final decisions regarding claims rest with the brand.
Minor dust specs may occur during application due to environmental factors, but we ensure the finish meets high-quality standards.
PPF is a 2D film applied to a 3D surface, so stretch marks in corners may occasionally occur. We keep this to a minimum.
Deep scratches may not heal, but in most cases, PPF absorbs the impact and prevents damage to the original paint.
Like all materials, PPF may slightly yellow over time due to oxidation, but with high-quality films, this happens gradually.
On repainted panels, PPF may cause peeling when removed due to strong adhesion. Warranty is not applicable on repainted areas.
For complex-shaped panels, film joints may be used to ensure proper adhesion. We avoid them unless absolutely necessary.

pricing.disclaimer: Pricing may vary depending on the size and model of your vehicle.

services.tagline: Nano-Technology-Based Protection for Lasting Shine & Defense
introduction: At Shalom Car & Bike Detailing Services, we offer advanced ceramic coating solutions that use cutting-edge nano-technology to protect your vehicle’s surface.

The coating forms a crystallized 9H or 10H hardness layer over the factory clear coat, providing a durable shield against: light scratches, chemical stains and acid etching, harmful UV rays, oxidation and paint fading.
Along with protection, the hydrophobic effect reduces water spots and makes regular cleaning much easier.
keyBenefits: 9H / 10H hardness for superior surface protection
Hydrophobic properties that repel water, dirt, and mud
UV resistance to prevent paint fading and dullness
High-gloss finish for a showroom-like appearance
Resistance to contaminants like bird droppings, tree sap, and road grime
importantNotes: The durability of the coating depends on driving conditions and regular care.
No coating is completely scratch-proof. Daily washing and proper maintenance are still necessary.
Always wash with clean microfiber towels and low-TDS water to avoid swirl marks.
Annual maintenance is mandatory for ceramic-coated vehicles. This is a paid service.
Warranty covers issues like discoloration, patchiness, peeling, or cracking—but not third-party painted or repainted panels.
Maintenance charges may vary based on market conditions and how the vehicle is maintained.

pricing.disclaimer: Final pricing depends on the size, condition, and type of your vehicle.

services.tagline: The Next Generation in Surface Protection
introduction: At Shalom Car & Bike Detailing Services, we bring you the latest innovation in surface protection — Graphene Coating.

This advanced nano-coating builds on ceramic technology and enhances it with graphene, the strongest known material on Earth. The result? Better heat resistance, extreme hydrophobicity, and unmatched durability for your vehicle’s paint.
keyBenefits: Superior water beading with an ultra-slick hydrophobic finish
Advanced heat resistance reduces chances of water spots and oxidation
Increased scratch resistance for long-lasting protection
Anti-static properties help keep dust and dirt away longer
Longer lifespan compared to traditional ceramic coatings

whyChoose.heading: Why Choose Graphene Over Ceramic?
whyChoose.description: While ceramic coatings offer excellent durability and gloss, graphene takes it a step further. It delivers added slickness, higher endurance under harsh conditions, and better UV/chemical resistance. Ideal for customers seeking premium-level protection and performance with a stunning visual finish.

importantNotes: Regular care is required to maintain maximum performance.
Annual maintenance service is recommended (chargeable).
No coating is completely scratch-proof, but graphene has higher resistance than ceramic.
Warranty does not cover repainted panels.
Issues like discoloration, peeling, or patchiness are covered under the warranty.

pricing.disclaimer: Pricing may vary depending on your vehicle’s size, condition, and coverage area.
